title: Patterns and reasoning

lessons.objective: Find the repeating unit before predicting the next item.
Check a proposed number rule against every step.
Distinguish turning a shape from reflecting it.
Sort objects by two rules at once.
Identify what must follow from the stated facts.
Read separate Venn-diagram regions and avoid double counting shared members.
Distinguish the probability of a whole sequence from the next independent flip under a fair-coin model.

outcomes: Find the repeating unit before predicting the next item.
Check a proposed number rule against every step.
Distinguish turning a shape from reflecting it.
Sort objects by two rules at once.
Identify what must follow from the stated facts.
Read separate Venn-diagram regions and avoid double counting shared members.
Separate a future sequence from a single next event when reasoning about fair, independent coin flips.
description: Seven short lessons: find patterns, turn shapes, combine rules, count overlaps and discover why a fair coin does not remember earlier flips. Optional quizzes included.
introduction:
Find a repeating unit, test a number rule and change your viewpoint. Then combine conditions, check conclusions and count shared members without counting them twice.

Finish with a coin that seems to be on a streak. Can earlier outcomes tell you what must happen next? Follow the assumptions and try the small examples at your own pace. Short quizzes are optional.
prerequisites: Basic counting. No previous logic lessons needed.
